title: Living Room Restoration — Future Barre Studio
summary: Original floors, exposed shiplap, and a repaired plank ceiling in the former living room being prepared as the future barre studio.
searchSummary: Former living-room restoration with original floors, exposed shiplap, reclaimed ceiling repairs, and an explicit future barre studio use.
stage: Renovation documented; future barre studio move not confirmed
sourceLabel: Former living room restoration journal and Home Reno - Studio Google Photos album

occupancy.label: Living Room Restoration — Future Barre Studio

gallery.caption: The Studio nearing completion on August 26, 2026: exposed wood flooring, painted walls and ceiling, and the retained timber wall.
gallery.alt: A light wood floor extends beneath white walls and a white plank ceiling, with tall windows and a dark door in the timber wall.

gallery.caption: The former living room at the start of the recorded work, March 16, 2026.
gallery.alt: Blue walls and white trim surround a worn brown wood floor, with a shop vacuum in the room.

gallery.caption: Hand tools and lifted finish at the edge of the original floor, March 16, 2026.
gallery.alt: Scrapers and curled finish shavings lie on wood flooring beside a floor register and white baseboard.

introduction: The former living room in the 1894 residence is being restored as the future home of the barre studio and Repair Shop. The room is not yet the current studio.
evidenceBoundary: The journal and three selected photographs document renovation through August 30, 2026. They do not establish that the studio move has occurred or that the room is currently occupied as a barre studio.
